name: Buses
summary: Air readings from SenseCAP sensors on school buses: temperature, humidity, CO2 and, where fitted, particles. Positions are never public.

el.name: Λεωφορεία
el.summary: Μετρήσεις αέρα από αισθητήρες SenseCAP σε λεωφορεία σχολείων: θερμοκρασία, υγρασία, CO2 και, όπου υπάρχουν, σωματίδια. Οι θέσεις δεν είναι ποτέ δημόσιες.

coverage.area: School bus routes around the four schools

variables.note: only where a sensor has a particle channel

quality.uncertainty: Measures the air inside the bus, which CO2 from passengers dominates. Doors opening at stops changes it.
known_issues: CO2 follows the number of passengers and open windows, not the street

privacy.note: Exact positions of cars and buses are never public. Public positions are at least 2 hours old and rounded to 0.01 degree (about 1 km).

use_for: Comparing a full bus with an empty one
not_for: Claiming what the whole city breathes
